shopping_list.close_modal.title: Close shopping list
shopping_list.close_modal.intro: Close this list and start a new one. Already-bought items stay on the closed list; choose below which other items, if any, to bring forward to the new list.
shopping_list.close_modal.carry_unpurcha: Carry forward items not yet bought
Items that are neither bought nor cancelled will be added to the new list.
shopping_list.close_modal.carry_cancelle: Cancelled items will be added to the new list, no longer marked as cancelled.
shopping_list.close_modal.submit: Close list and start a new one
shopping_list.action_rejected: That change could not be made because the list has changed. It will now be refreshed.
